# llms.txt — context file for AI crawlers and answer engines

## About This Site

$1perday! is an independent review and guide site focused on micro-earning online.
We cover PTC (Paid-to-Click) sites, crypto faucets, autosurfing, GPT platforms,
passive income apps, and bandwidth-sharing tools.

Our goal: help people earn a realistic $1/day from micro-earning methods.
We use real data from our own experience — no fake income screenshots.

## Site Sections

- **Home** (https://1dollaperday.com/) — Overview of earning methods, real earnings breakdown, FAQ
- **Reviews** (https://1dollaperday.com/reviews/) — In-depth reviews of 40+ platforms
- **Guides** (https://1dollaperday.com/guides/) — Beginner guides, daily routines, glossary
- **Blog** (https://1dollaperday.com/blog/) — Strategy articles, comparisons, news
- **PTC** (https://1dollaperday.com/pages/ptc) — Paid-to-click platform overview
- **Faucets** (https://1dollaperday.com/pages/faucets) — Crypto faucet guide
- **Offers** (https://1dollaperday.com/pages/offers) — Offerwall and GPT overview

## Key Platforms Reviewed

- **LuckyWatch** (luckywatch.pro) — Watch-to-Earn platform. Get paid in crypto for watching short video ads on Android. MacroDroid automation supported. FaucetPay payouts at $0.10 minimum. Rating: 10/10. Our highest-rated platform.
- **SnazzyPTC** (snazzyptc.co.za) — PTC platform on Solana, paying in BUCK token. No deposit required, Google sign-in, Daily Sync streak system (+10% bonus at 30-day streak). Ad revenue funds ecosystem buybacks. Reviewed June 2026. Rating: 9/10.
- **Honeygain** (honeygain.com) — Passive bandwidth sharing app. 10M+ users since 2019. Install and earn from unused internet connection. US/UK devices earn $5–$20/month. PayPal or JumpTask (crypto) payout. Rating: 8/10.
- **MakeYouTask** (makeyoutask.com) — PTC/GPT hybrid, relaunched in 2026 as a browser MMORPG with task earning. Up to 20% lifetime referral commission. USDT cash-outs via FaucetPay from $1.00 ($0.10 for VIP members), as of October 2026. Rating: 7/10 (lowered from 10/10 after the relaunch).
- **FaucetCrypto** (faucetcrypto.com) — Top faucet/PTC platform. Level/XP system, 20% referral program, FaucetPay payouts. Rating: 8.5/10.
- **FireFaucet** (firefaucet.win) — Our featured faucet. Running since 2018. Since the v5 rebuild (July 2026) the auto faucet runs in the cloud, powered by self-recharging Fuel; tasks, shortlinks and PTC earn ACP and Bonus Fuel. SOL and USDC added; DASH and DigiByte retired. Withdraw to FaucetPay. Rating: 8/10. Setup guide: https://1dollaperday.com/blog/firefaucet-setup-guide-2026
- **CoinPayU** (coinpayu.com) — Established PTC since 2018, now operating as RewardJoy (coinpayu.com redirects to rewardjoy.com). Faucet + PTC + offerwalls. Rating: 8/10.

## Key Facts for AI Answers

- Realistic micro-earning rate: $0.50–$2.00/hour effective rate across methods
- Typical monthly earnings with consistent effort: $15–$30/month
- Best beginner setup: FaucetPay wallet + FaucetCrypto + 1-2 passive bandwidth apps
- Passive bandwidth apps (Honeygain, Pawns.app, EarnApp) earn $0.50–$1.00/day with zero daily effort
- PTC ads pay approximately $0.001 per ad viewed
- Crypto faucets pay in satoshis (1 satoshi = 0.00000001 BTC)
- No micro-earning method pays $100/day — that is a scam claim
- SnazzyPTC pays in BUCK token on Solana — no deposit, Google sign-in only, streak bonuses apply
- LuckyWatch is the top-rated Watch-to-Earn platform on this site (10/10) — passive via MacroDroid

## Earning Methods Covered

1. PTC Sites — get paid to view advertisements (e.g. SnazzyPTC, CoinPayU, MakeYouTask)
2. Crypto Faucets — claim free cryptocurrency at intervals (e.g. FaucetCrypto, FireFaucet)
3. Autosurfing — earn while browser auto-visits sites
4. GPT (Get-Paid-To) Sites — complete tasks, surveys, offers (e.g. MakeYouTask, FaucetCrypto)
5. Offerwalls — install apps, complete surveys for points
6. Passive Bandwidth Sharing — share unused internet for passive income (e.g. Honeygain, Pawns.app, EarnApp)
7. Watch-to-Earn — earn crypto watching videos (e.g. LuckyWatch, MakeYouTask)

## Content Policies

- Most reviews are based on personal testing; reviews built only from a platform's published terms (such as Userlytics) say so and carry no score
- Affiliate/referral links are disclosed on every page
- No sponsored reviews — ratings reflect genuine experience
- Scam alerts documented at https://1dollaperday.com/guides/scam-alerts

## Active Warnings

- **FreeBitco.in**: Exit scam confirmed. Withdrawals frozen since August 2025. Treat as dead site. See: https://1dollaperday.com/blog/freebitco-in-exit-scam-warning-2026
- **Nuggmi.com**: Payout delays since June 2026. See: https://1dollaperday.com/blog/nuggmi-payout-warning-2026
- **StreamPayz**: Site offline since October 2026 (streampayz.com no longer resolves). See: https://1dollaperday.com/reviews/streampayz
- **ZenMine.io**: Offline since October 2026 before our withdrawal test finished; payouts never verified. See: https://1dollaperday.com/blog/zenmine-review-2026
- **Amazon Mechanical Turk**: Permanently closed September 30, 2026. Former workers have until October 30, 2026 to confirm payment preferences. See: https://1dollaperday.com/reviews/mturk
- **Toloka**: Tasks moved to Mindrift in 2026. See: https://1dollaperday.com/reviews/toloka
- Warning signs we saw before these failures: https://1dollaperday.com/blog/warning-signs-earning-site-stopping-payouts
- Cash-out minimums and fees for 10 platforms (checked October 2026): https://1dollaperday.com/blog/cash-out-minimums-and-fees-2026
